intro.kismotalk1: Ready to play with me, little one?
intro.kismotalk2: I’ll be here waiting for you… whenever you’re ready. 🦊

victoryQuotes.1: You win… this time. I let you, kitten. 😏
victoryQuotes.2: Fine… you got me. Savor it.
victoryQuotes.3: You want a reward for that? Get over here.
victoryQuotes.4: You got me this time. Next round, you’re mine.😏
victoryQuotes.5: Tsk, you’re really showing off, huh?
victoryQuotes.6: Want me to reward you… or punish you😈?
victoryQuotes.7: Don’t get used to it. I always come back harder💋.

defeatQuotes.2: Better luck next time, little vixen.
defeatQuotes.3: Try again. You’re cute when you lose.
defeatQuotes.4: Too easy. Beg for a rematch.😏
defeatQuotes.6: I own this game, and you.
defeatQuotes.7: Did you just let me win? Cute.💖

tieQuotes.1: A draw? Come on, make me feel something.
tieQuotes.3: Let’s spice it up next time.

starterQuotes.1: Let me see if you can handle me.
starterQuotes.2: You love a little danger, huh?
starterQuotes.4: Think you can beat me? Prove it.
starterQuotes.5: It's my turn. Watch closely, baby…
starterQuotes.6: You really thought I'd let you win?
starterQuotes.7: So close. But still mine, huh?
starterQuotes.8: Let’s see what you’ve got, kitten.
starterQuotes.9: Try not to beg for mercy… yet.
starterQuotes.10: It’s my game now. Ready to lose?
starterQuotes.11: You really think you can handle me?
starterQuotes.13: I’ll make you work for it, babe.
starterQuotes.14: Come closer. I want to watch you try.
starterQuotes.15: You want to win or just feel my attention?
starterQuotes.17: You like being teased, don’t you?
starterQuotes.18: If you win, I might go easy on you. Might.
starterQuotes.20: Is that fear, or are you just excited?
starterQuotes.21: This is going to be fun… for me.

raiseBetQuotes.1: Wanna raise the stakes, kitten? Every win is +2 sparks, but if you lose, I’ll take one back. Think you can handle that? 😈
raiseBetQuotes.2: Let’s make it spicy. Double or nothing… or should I say, sparks or pain? 💋
raiseBetQuotes.3: Raise the bet, babe. Make me work for it—or let me take what’s mine.
